title: Cisco Webex Membership
description: Represents a person's relationship to a Webex room, including their role and access permissions.

roomId.description: The room ID for the membership.

personId.description: The person ID for the membership.

personEmail.description: The email address of the person.

personDisplayName.description: The display name of the person.

personOrgId.description: The organization ID of the person.

isModerator.description: Whether the person is a room moderator.

isRoomHidden.description: Whether the direct space is hidden for this member.

isMonitor.description: Whether the member is a monitoring bot.

created.description: Date and time the membership was created.
